sentences.en: A dog is a good friend to man.
The cat drinks milk from a dish.
A bird has wings and feathers.
Fish live in water.
The horse runs fast.
A cow gives us milk.
Sheep give us wool.
An animal needs food and water.
The insect is very small.
The bird moves its wings to fly.
The dog is at the foot of the bed.
A fish has a tail but no legs.
Is that animal a dog or a cat?
A bee makes honey from flowers.
A sheep gives us wool for cloth.
A pig lives on a farm.
The goat climbed the rock.
A monkey uses its hands to take food.
I saw a rat in the old house.
sentences.zh: 我在老房子里看到一只老鼠。

sentences.en: A snake has a long body and no legs.
sentences.zh: 蛇有长长的身体，没有腿。

sentences.en: A worm lives in the earth.
The wings of a bird are strong.
A fowl is a bird that lives on a farm.
sentences.zh: 家禽是生活在农场里的鸟。

sentences.en: The cow has a horn on its head.
The cat has a soft tail.
A bird has two wings to fly.
The feather of the bird was light.
The fish has a scale on its body.
